await page.evaluate('async () => {\n  const r = await fetch(\'/src/data/documents.ts\');\n  const t = await r.text();\n  // extract all id: \'xxx\' occurrences at top-level document definitions\n  const idMatches = [...t.matchAll(/\\n\\s{4}id:\\s*[\'"]([\\w-]+)[\'"]/g)].map(m => m[1]);\n  const relatedMatches = [...t.matchAll(/relatedDocuments:\\s*\\[([^\\]]*)\\]/g)].map(m => m[1]);\n  const linkMatches = [...t.matchAll(/(?:documentId|targetId|linkTo|refId):\\s*[\'"]([\\w-]+)[\'"]/g)].map(m=>m[1]);\n  return {idCount: idMatches.length, ids: idMatches, relatedSample: relatedMatches.slice(0,3), linkMatchesSample: linkMatches.slice(0,20), linkMatchesCount: linkMatches.length};\n}');
